new.power: Prima Nocta: Take one card from an opponent. If it's shiny, keep it.
new.lore: Two-thirds god, one-third jerk. He rings the city bell just to wake people up. The original toxic bachelor.

new.power: Wild Card: Cancels "Civilization" effects. Bonus damage if fighting alongside Gilgamesh.
new.lore: Created from clay to humble the champ. Knows the woods, the animals, and exactly how hard to punch a god.

new.power: Home Field Advantage: +2 Defense. Look at the brickwork—it's burnt brick, not sun-dried!
new.lore: The Absurdly Cool City. Three leagues of copper walls. Smells like oppression and cedar.

new.power: The Script: Rewrite the ending of the current turn.
new.lore: The oldest story ever sold. Warning: Contains missing fragments, plot holes, and a baffling

new.power: Civilize: Turn a 'Beast' card into a 'Sidekick' card. Takes 7 days (turns).
new.lore: Used "love arts" to weaken Enkidu's knees and boost his IQ. The original influencers were temple priestesses.

new.power: Dream Interpretation: Look at top 3 cards. Reorder them to favor your son.
new.lore: Gilgamesh's mom. She adopts Enkidu because her biological son is a handful. Always reads the spoilers.

new.power: Noise Complaint: Wipe the board (Flood). He can't sleep because humans are too loud.
new.lore: A Jerkass God. Tried to delete humanity for being too noisy. Even other gods think he goes too far.

new.power: Divine Intervention: Bind a monster with 13 winds so the hero can land a cheap shot.
new.lore: The Sun God. He hands out Cheat Codes (Axes, Swords) to Gilgamesh because he loves a winner.

new.power: Yandere Tantrum: If rejected, summon a 'Bull of Heaven' or a 'Zombie Apocalypse'.
new.lore: Goddess of Love and War. Don't date her. Ask her ex-boyfriends (who are now wolves and frogs).

new.power: Vicious Mockery: Inflict emotional damage. Force Ishtar to run to her daddy (Anu).
new.lore: A brutal verbal beatdown citing every ex-lover she destroyed. The first recorded 'Diss Track'.

new.power: Drought: Dries up the river. Opens sinkholes that swallow 200 men.
new.lore: Ishtar borrowed her sister's husband to wreck the city. A weapon of mass destruction with horns.

new.power: Did You Just Flip Off Cthulhu?: Instant respect. Instant death sentence.
new.lore: The ultimate Badass Boast. Enkidu taunts a goddess with beef. This will not end well.

new.power: Sacred Ground: Trespassers must roll for intimidation.
new.lore: A pristine nature reserve until two bros decided they needed lumber and glory. "Going to see the Elephant".

new.power: 7 Auras: Remove one aura per turn to make him vulnerable.
new.lore: Guardian of the forest. His face looks like entrails. He begged for mercy, but the script said "die".

new.power: Deus Ex Machina: Shamash immobilizes the boss so you can hit it.
new.lore: It's not a fair fight if the Sun God blinds your opponent with tornadoes. Total rig job.

new.power: Peer Pressure: Execute the target immediately. Gain Loot.
new.lore: Gilgamesh hesitated. Enkidu didn't. "If you let him go, he'll just come back for the sequel."

new.power: Dual Wielding: Attack twice. Requires Strength 60.
new.lore: Gold daggers weighing 4 talents each. Anime swords existed in 2100 BCE.

new.power: Civilization Upgrade: Lose 'Wild' trait, gain 'Depression'.
new.lore: The barber of Uruk transforms the beast. Now he can drink beer and wear uncomfortable clothes.

new.power: Craftsmanship: Construct a tribute to Enlil (who still hates you).
new.lore: They killed the guardian, stole the wood, and made a door for the god who hired the guardian. Mixed messages.

new.power: Foreshadowing: Predict the next Trap card.
new.lore: Every night, a new nightmare. Enkidu spins it as 'Reverse Psychology' for success. He was wrong.

new.power: Executive Decision: Kill one hero. (They chose Enkidu because Gilgamesh is the franchise star).
new.lore: Someone has to pay for the Bull. It can't be the King. Sorry, Enkidu.

new.power: Wasting Away: Loses 1 HP per day for 12 days.
new.lore: A mysterious divine illness. The slow agony of realizing you were just a plot device.

new.power: Reality Check: Gilgamesh gains 'Mortality Phobia'.
new.lore: Gilgamesh refused to bury him for 7 days until... well, until nature happened. Grief is messy.

new.power: Merchandising: Gain prestige, but lose your best friend.
new.lore: The funeral was lavish. The grief was loud. The statue is solid gold. It doesn't help.

new.power: Intimidate: Scares tavern owners. Lowers Charisma.
new.lore: He rejects the silk robes of the King to cosplay as his dead friend's wild past. Hourglass Plot.

new.power: Panic: Run to the end of the world. Do not stop for side quests.
new.lore: "Am I not like him? Must I lie down too?" The first recorded existential crisis.

new.power: Wander: Discard your hand to draw new cards from the 'Unknown' deck.
new.lore: Roaming the wilderness eating raw meat. It's not a vacation; it's a trauma response.

new.power: Nihilism: Negate all 'Glory' points.
new.lore: "Man is snapped off like a reed in the canebrake." We are here, then we are gone. Bummer.

new.power: Threshold: Only those with "Despair" status may enter.
new.lore: The gate where the sun rises and sets. The VIP entrance to the God Realm.

new.power: Bouncer: "You're not on the list." Check ID. Their glance is death.
new.lore: But they are actually pretty chill once you explain you're grieving.

new.power: Speed Run: Roll dice. If you fail, the Sun catches you. Outrun the Fireball!
new.lore: 12 leagues of total darkness. He has to race the Sun God's commute.

new.power: Shiny Distraction: Skip a turn to stare at the bling.
new.lore: After the darkness, a trippy crystal forest. Siduri lives near here.

new.power: Real Talk: "Fill your belly. Dance and play." Heals 10 HP.
new.lore: The tavern at the end of the universe. She gives the best advice in the book: Carpe Diem. Gilgamesh ignores it.

new.power: Transport: Cross the Waters of Death.
new.lore: He runs the taxi service to the immortal. Gets fired for bringing a smelly tourist along.

new.power: Applied Phlebotinum: Safe passage. If broken, game over.
new.lore: Nobody knows what they are. Gilgamesh smashed them in a tantrum. Nice job breaking it, Hero.

new.power: Disposable Tools: Use once, then throw away.
new.lore: Since he broke the engine (Stone Things), he has to push the boat. Can't touch the water or you die.

new.power: Immortality: Cannot be killed. Bored by your problems.
new.lore: The only human to retire from the game. He survived the Flood. Tired of visitors.

new.power: Reset Button: Destroy all Civilization cards.
new.lore: The gods flooded the earth because they couldn't sleep. The original "Noah's Ark" story (but with a cube).

new.power: Preserver of Life: Survive the wipe.
new.lore: It wasn't a boat shape. It was a giant watertight box. Loaded with gold, family, and beasts.

new.power: Fail State: If you can't conquer Sleep, you can't conquer Death.
new.lore: Gilgamesh tries to stay awake for 7 days. Passes out immediately. A humiliating defeat.

new.power: Power: Evidence: Prove the player was asleep/AFK.
new.lore: Utnapishtim's wife baked one loaf for every day he slept. You can't argue with mold.

new.power: Power: Rejuvenation: Restores youth (does not grant immortality).
new.lore: Deep under the Apsu. Prick your hands to get it. Gilgamesh wants to test it on old men first. Too clever by half.

new.power: Power: Vulnerability: Leave your inventory unguarded.
new.lore: One moment of inattention. That's all it takes.

new.power: Power: The Theft: Steal the winning item. Gain 'New Skin'.
new.lore: The Snake eats the plant and becomes young again. The true winner of the Epic. Diabolus ex Machina.

new.power: Power: Bookends: The story ends where it began.
new.lore: He didn't bring the plant, but he brought the story. "Go up, Urshanabi, walk on the walls of Uruk."

new.power: Power: Infrastructure: Build something that lasts longer than meat.
new.lore: Immortality isn't living forever; it's building a city that people still talk about 4,000 years later.

new.power: Power: The Text: Publish your autobiography.
new.lore: Gilgamesh wrote his own legend. He lost the wrestling match with Death, but won the PR war.

new.power: Power: Wisdom: Swap 'Arrogance' for 'Acceptance'.
new.lore: Life is short. Eat good food, love your family, wear clean clothes. Death is inevitable. Deal with it.

new.power: Power: Continuity Error: Enkidu is alive again?
new.lore: An incoherent appendix where Enkidu is a servant, not a friend. A 'Gainax Ending' that makes no sense.

new.power: Power: Lost Toys: Drop items into the Netherworld.
new.lore: Gilgamesh loses his toys. Enkidu goes to fetch them. The plot of Tablet XII is... weird.

new.power: Power: Don't Do It: If you wear clean clothes, the dead will attack you.
new.lore: Too Dumb to Live. Gilgamesh gave specific stealth instructions. Enkidu ignored all of them.

new.power: Power: Final Goodbye: A bleak Q&A session about rotting corpses.
new.lore: 'Tell me the order of the Netherworld.' You don't want to know. It's mostly dust and eating clay.
GUARANTEED HIGH ALTITUDE!

new.lore: Bread may contain divine curses.
